Ekushey with Foring
2018-02-20T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/ekushey-foring-1536988

Fashion house Foring is celebrating this February 21 with a different view. Their new collection includes saris, panjabis, kamiz sets, t-shirts etc. in black, white, and grey. The collection has hand and machine embroidery, block designs as well as appliqués and many other decorative items.

For more information, please visit www.facebook.com/Foring-Ltd-418926821602453 or www.foringbd.com
